messages:
maria: heads-up — deploybot tried to swap engine bundle `engine-v2.14-quant` into night window at 01:00 UTC but preflight failed on ~4% of hosts with a bundlestamp mismatch. seeing checksum drift for matmul kernels on a subset of A100s.

deploybot: automated preflight report: 1728390000 - swap started. 96% hosts: smoke ok. 4% hosts: FAIL (bundlestamp != expected). failing hosts: gpu-us-west-2-i-03, gpu-us-west-2-i-07. error snippet: ```ERROR: bundlestamp mismatch: expected=0x7f3b2a got=0x6e2f5c at kernel matmul_q4.so```

josh: can we confirm this is a packaging/checksum issue or a kernel incompat?

maria: quick grep of artifacts shows two different `matmul_q4.so` published into the same release bundle (CI race). looks like last-minute backport landed after bundle stamp was computed.

anya: if it's CI race, rollback/pin to previous bundle is safe. impact likely limited to night window hosts but we should treat as potentially unsafe for canary traffic.

sam: propose immediate action: 1) hold current swap (cancel remaining hosts), 2) pin region `us-west-2` to `engine-v2.13` via deploybot sticky pin, 3) rebuild `engine-v2.14` with deterministic bundlestamp and re-run preflight.

maria: agreed. can someone run the pin? I don't want manual clicks in the middle of the night.

kevin: I can run the pin. command: `deploybot pin --region us-west-2 --bundle engine-v2.13 --reason "bundlestamp mismatch 1728390000" --ttl 24h`

deploybot: pin request acknowledged. Pin created: us-west-2 -> engine-v2.13. TTL 24h. Notifying routing and autoscale.

josh: also add a release-note fragment so PMs know why night traffic saw a hold. snippet: "Night swap paused due to bundlestamp mismatch detected in preflight; teams rebuilding deterministic artifact. No user-facing impact observed; regional pin in effect as precaution." Sam or Maria can paste into release notes?

sam: pasted to draft release notes and flagged for ops-notify. `RELEASE_NOTE_SNIPPET: Night swap paused — bundlestamp mismatch on matmul kernel; us-west-2 pinned to engine-v2.13 while rebuild occurs.`

maria: next steps: 1) CI team to re-run deterministic build and publish new bundle with verifiable stamp, 2) eng-runtime to run targeted preflight on the two failing hosts after rebuild, 3) decide canary slice (5% in us-east-1) for re-swap. timeline?

anya: CI estimate 45m for rebuild + artifact promotion. I can schedule preflight run immediately after promotion and tag this thread with results.

kevin: i'll keep the pin TTL at 24h for now, extend if rebuild takes longer. if preflight passes we'll unpin and resume staged rollout during next quiet window.

maria: perfect. owners: CI=anya, pin/ops=kevin, release note/sync=sam. tagging oncall for telemetry watch once we resume canary. :eyes:

deploybot: action summary: swap halted, us-west-2 pinned -> engine-v2.13, preflight failed on 2 hosts. followups: rebuild + deterministic publish (owner: anya), re-run preflight (owner: anya), unpin/continue staged rollout when green (owner: kevin).

josh: thanks team. keep this thread updated with preflight results. if CI reproduces the mismatched artifact locally, call for a hotfix tag.

maria: will do — marking thread resolved for night window hold. I left a quick checklist in the draft release notes for handoff to morning shift.
